choice.basis: The state incidence map legend indicates that the pale-yellow color corresponds to the 'High' end of the scale (near 100), while dark burgundy/maroon corresponds to the 'Low' end (near 0). Reviewing the three options: West Virginia (WV) is filled with pale yellow (high incidence), Utah (UT) is filled with dark burgundy (low incidence), and Alabama (AL) is filled with pale yellow (high incidence). Both WV and AL appear to be at the highest incidence level among the choices, but WV is clearly mapped to the highest value category. Therefore, WV should be routed to the highest-incidence priority follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Open West Virginia (WV) incidence detail for priority follow-up
